extracted.intended_audience: authors, reviewers, editors, and researchers involved in conducting and reporting observational epidemiologic studies
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for writing and reporting observational epidemiology studies so that methods and findings are transparently and completely reported for journal publication and appraisal.

rubrics_metrics.name: STROBE — Strengthening the Reporting of Observational studies in Epidemiology (overall aim)
rubrics_metrics.description: The STROBE Statement is an international, collaborative initiative ... with the common aim of STrengthening the Reporting of OBservational studies in Epidemiology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: STROBE provides guidance intended to improve the reporting quality of observational studies; it is produced by epidemiologists, methodologists, statisticians, researchers and journal editors and is being endorsed by a growing number of biomedical journals. Explanatory papers and authorized translations (e.g., Spanish, Japanese) are available from the STROBE website.
